heroSourceLine: Source: NCSD 2026–27 Elementary, Middle School, and High School student calendars
heroSummary: North Clackamas students in grades 1–6 and grade 9 start Tuesday, September 8, 2026. Grades 7–8 and 10–12 start Wednesday, September 9, and kindergarten starts Monday, September 14. Elementary students finish June 17, 2027; middle and high school students finish June 21, subject to emergency make-up days. NCSD uses separate calendars for elementary, middle, and high school students, so check the calendar for your student’s level.
calendarNotes: NCSD publishes separate Elementary, Middle School, and High School calendars, so no single PDF represents every student. Grades 1–5, grade 6, and grade 9 begin September 8; grades 7–8 and 10–12 begin September 9; kindergarten begins September 14. Elementary students have additional no-school days on November 20, January 4, April 28, and May 12 that do not appear as student closures on the middle and high school calendars. Middle school calendars mark 31 L1 or L2 late-start Wednesdays, while high school calendars show rotating period numbers and finals schedules in February and June. Middle and high school students return from Winter Break January 4, but elementary students return January 5 after a staff workday. Elementary school ends June 17 with possible emergency make-up days June 21–24; middle and high school end June 21 with possible make-up days June 22–25. The official PDFs were updated on different dates, and families should use the current level-specific PDF or translation before making plans.

calendarFaqs.q: When does North Clackamas School District start in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Grades 1–5, grade 6, and grade 9 start Tuesday, September 8, 2026. Grades 7–8 and 10–12 start September 9, and kindergarten starts September 14.

calendarFaqs.q: Which NCSD calendar should my student use?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the Elementary, Middle School, or High School student calendar that matches your student’s school level. First days, last days, grading dates, late starts, finals, and make-up windows differ by level.

calendarFaqs.q: When is North Clackamas Winter Break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. Middle and high school students return January 4; elementary students return January 5 after a January 4 workday.

calendarFaqs.q: When is North Clackamas Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 22, through Friday, March 26, 2027. Students return Monday, March 29.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for NCSD in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Elementary students finish Thursday, June 17, 2027. Middle and high school students finish Monday, June 21. Later June dates only become attendance days if NCSD uses the emergency make-up windows.

calendarFaqs.q: What are the NCSD middle-school late-start dates?
calendarFaqs.a: The official Middle School calendar marks 31 Wednesdays as L1 or L2 late starts from September 16 through June 9. The complete date list is on this page; confirm the actual bell time with the student’s school.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 9, 2026, against NCSD’s official calendar page and the complete Elementary, Middle School, and High School student calendar PDFs.
sourceReviewDetailsTitle: How we verified the three NCSD calendars
sourceReviewDetails: The Elementary and High School PDFs are marked updated June 18, 2026; the Middle School PDF is marked updated June 29, 2026.
We manually checked each calendar’s grid and legend, including school-level dates, L1/L2 late starts, finals periods, grading dates, and no-school markings.

The NCSD calendar page currently lists the elementary last day as June 17, 2026 in its 2026–27 section. The current Elementary PDF shows June 17, 2027, so this page uses the PDF date and notes the discrepancy here.
The Middle and High School PDFs state that the final calendar is subject to bargaining and available resources.
Because the Middle School PDF does not define the L1/L2 bell times, we do not list a start time.
The .ics file is a one-time import and excludes middle-school late starts and high-school finals.
Check the student’s school for bell times, campus events, and revisions published after this review.
